lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three primary horizontal tiers posterior to the gill slits, with a mean inter-centroid distance appearing roughly uniform along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a visible grid-like pattern where the spots serve as anchor nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges extending posteriorly from the dorsal margin of the gill region, displaying a high-contrast transition from light-toned dorsal surfaces to shadowed ventral facets.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct vertical, dark-pigmented lacerations or deep scars are present on the upper lateral flank, positioned immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit and superior to the pectoral fin origin.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of small, irregular high-luminance points is localized on the dorsal surface and leading edge of the visible pectoral fin.
